Package hkust.marketplace.model

Class Listing

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.model.Listing
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Listing extends Object implements Serializable
An item posted by a seller for sale, lending or giveaway. Buyers only see listings whose status is browsable (Live, Reserved or Lent).

      public Listing(String id, String sellerId, ListingType type, String title, Category category, Condition condition, String description, String meetupLocation, LocalDateTime postedAt)
      Creates a listing.
      Parameters:
      id - unique id
      sellerId - id of the seller who posted it
      type - sell, lend or giveaway
      title - item name
      category - category
      condition - condition
      description - full description
      meetupLocation - HKUST meet-up location
      postedAt - submission time
